about: PingPath change log, newest first. Every update adds an entry at the top whose version matches package.json; the build stops if it doesn't (scripts/check-tour.mjs). audience: everyone = shown to all users in What's new; admin = shown only to admins. Entries marked reconstructed were written afterwards from the deploy history, before notes were kept.

releases.title: New address: pingpath.mkcworkspace.com
releases.summary: PingPath moved to its own address, and its code is now kept in GitHub.

changes.title: PingPath has a new address
changes.detail: Open pingpath.mkcworkspace.com, sign in once, and add it to your home screen again. The old link still works.

changes.title: Code kept in GitHub
changes.detail: PingPath's code now lives in c3jumpw/mkp-tools, folder pingpath, next to Circuit Book, so every change is saved and can be traced.

changes.title: Test links locked
changes.detail: Vercel's preview links for PingPath now need a Vercel login. Only the live addresses are public.

releases.title: Update notes that follow your account
releases.summary: An Admin page with the full history of changes, and What's new notes that follow each person's account and only show what applies to them.

changes.title: What's new follows your account
changes.detail: After an update, this note shows the first time you open PingPath on any device, once. If you missed a few updates, it catches you up on all of them.

changes.title: Only the changes that apply to you
changes.detail: Notes about the owner's setup are left out of everyone else's What's new.

changes.title: Admin page with the full change log
changes.detail: Settings › Admin lists every update since launch, oldest or newest first, with who each change applies to. Download it as a spreadsheet (CSV) or a data file (JSON) to keep a copy.

changes.title: Admin role
changes.detail: The owner's login is the admin. Admins see the Admin page and admin-only update notes. Nobody, admins included, can see anyone else's board.

changes.title: New address: pingpath.mkcworkspace.com
changes.detail: Connected to the app. It starts working once its CNAME record is added at GoDaddy. The old pingpath-two.vercel.app link keeps working.

changes.title: Updates can't skip the change log
changes.detail: Publishing stops if a new version has no entry here, a change doesn't say who it applies to, or the dates are out of order.

releases.title: Getting started tour
releases.summary: A step-by-step tour of every screen, on the real app filled with sample people.

changes.title: Getting started tour
changes.detail: Every screen, step by step, using the real app with sample people and numbered callouts. Settings › Getting started tour.

changes.title: What's new notes
changes.detail: A note on Home after each update, and Settings › What's new any time.

changes.title: Guide links into the tour
changes.detail: Each section of the guide has a Show me in the tour link.

changes.title: Clearer sign-up page
changes.detail: Create your account now explains that each login is its own private board.

changes.title: Owner track in the tour
changes.detail: Accounts and invites, installing on a phone, the calendar link and jobs done outside the app.

changes.title: Updates can't skip the tour
changes.detail: Publishing stops if a page has no tour step or a version has no release notes.

releases.title: Illustrated guide
releases.summary: A guide page with pictures of every screen.

changes.title: Illustrated guide
changes.detail: Pictures of every screen with numbered explanations. Tap ? at the top, or Settings › How to use PingPath.

changes.title: Owner section in the guide
changes.detail: Accounts and invites, installing on phones, and owner jobs done in Vercel and Supabase.

releases.title: Second numbers, special dates and easier tags

changes.title: Second phone number with a label
changes.detail: Work, Home, or your own word. Wishes and blasts can use either number.

changes.title: Special dates
changes.detail: Anniversaries or any named event, as many as you like for each person.

changes.title: Edit anyone from a tag's page
changes.detail: Tap a person on a tag to change their details without leaving the page.

changes.title: Bottom menu easier to tap on iPhone
changes.detail: It now sits above the iPhone home bar.

changes.title: Birthdays and special dates on Home
changes.detail: Today, the week ahead, and a month calendar.

changes.title: Send wishes in one tap
changes.detail: The message opens in Text, WhatsApp, Email or Instagram, and Home remembers who you've wished this year.

changes.title: Google Calendar sync
changes.detail: Connect your birthdays calendar with its secret link. Names that match a contact are linked automatically.

changes.title: Quick add
changes.detail: Add a person with their numbers, birthday and a special date in one form.

releases.title: PingPath launches
releases.summary: First version, published September 18, followed by fixes and polish through September 27.

changes.title: Contacts
changes.detail: Search, filters, statuses, hiding, and bulk actions.

changes.title: Tags
changes.detail: Group people and filter by group.

changes.title: Blasts with message steps
changes.detail: Write each step once with name fill-ins, add people, and track who's had which step.

changes.title: Blast Deck
changes.detail: Work through one step for everyone, one card at a time.

changes.title: Import and find duplicates
changes.detail: Bring in a CSV list, and find people who share a phone, email or name.

changes.title: Works like an app on your phone
changes.detail: Add it to your home screen and it opens full-screen.

changes.title: Invite-only accounts
changes.detail: New accounts need the invite code, and each login is its own private board.
